description: This file defines a middleware class for a web application built with Starlette. The middleware, named AuditMiddleware, intercepts incoming HTTP requests to log audit information such as user ID, request path, method, IP address, and timestamp into a MongoDB collection.

classes.name: AuditMiddleware
classes.description: A middleware class that records audit logs for each HTTP request processed by the application.

methods.name: __init__(self, app: ASGIApp)
methods.description: Initializes the AuditMiddleware instance, calling the parent constructor.

methods.name: dispatch(self, request: Request, call_next: Callable)
methods.description: Asynchronously processes each request, logs audit information into the database, and returns the response.

ctags.name: dispatch
ctags.pattern: /^    async def dispatch(self, request: Request, call_next: Callable):$/
